summary: Preserve the curated Cosmos command layer while hardening tenant isolation, GraphQL transport, credential input, pagination, exports, snapshots, and HTTP boundaries.
reason: Cosmos exposes an undocumented GraphQL BFF whose captured operations are unsuitable as a public CLI. Pre-publication review also found raw agent transports, argv credential exposure, incomplete pagination, unsafe overwrite annotations, account-agnostic snapshots, and unbounded provider responses.
validated_outcome: Full Go tests, vet, build, tenant-profile live validation, and govulncheck pass on Go 1.26.6; the full authenticated dogfood matrix passed without failures.
